name: Narukami Subaru
source:
Shinji's homeroom teacher. He's quite popular with the girls because of his stunning good looks, but he's also a huge narcissist and a weirdo who peppers his speech with English words, which ruins the effect.
[spoiler]He's deathly afraid of dogs.[/spoiler]
translation:
Shinji's homeroom teacher. He's quite popular with the girls because of his stunning good looks, but he's also a huge narcissist and a weirdo who peppers his speech with English words, which ruins the effect.
[spoiler]He's deathly afraid of dogs.[/spoiler]
